question_uz: Kompaniyaning narx strategiyasidagi eng asosiy muvozanat qoidasi nima?
question_en: What is the fundamental balance rule in marketing pricing strategy?
options_uz: Narx har doim nolga teng bo'lishi shart

Narx har kuni 100 barobar o'zgarishi shart
Narx tannarxdan yuqori (Price floor) va xaridor qadrlagan qiymatdan past (Price ceiling) bo'lishi shart
options_en: Price is set only with competitors' written consent
Price must be above product costs (Price floor) and below customer value perceptions (Price ceiling)
